newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end slightly up, lack of interest.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end slightly up, lack of interest.

text.p: French shares finished the last session before Christmas Day with a very small gain in moderate volume on Tuesday, traders said.

"There's really nothing to say about this market, everybody's thinking about their capon and champagne," one broker said. There was scant news or themes to stir interest and other major European centres had already closed.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 2.11 points or 0.09 percent at 2,289.55. The CAC-40 futures contract was down at 2,288 from 2,296 on Monday's close.
Volume was 2.78 billion francs, of which 1.82 billion in CAC-40 shares.
News the government wants to sell the SFP production studio to Cie Generale des Eaux and Havas prompted a shrug. "Not much interest," said a broker.
Generale des Eaux closed down 0.47 percent at 632, while media group Havas finished up 0.36 percent at 362.50.
Carmaker Renault added 0.90 percent to 112 francs, after near 6.63 percent rise on Monday.

Dassault Aviation, which started the year at 316 francs, closed at 1,156, up 3.12 percent from Monday. Dassault and merger partner Aerospatiale are rumoured to be considering a bid for Thomson-CSF, unchanged at 168.50.
